transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Hello, do you have any questions about your cataract surgery or recovery?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, I do have a few questions. First, when can I start doing a little bit of gardening?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: You can go back to light exercise after 1 week, and that includes gardening. Please avoid strenuous work or heavy lifting for a month. Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Thank you for that information. My next question is, when can I start using my eye gel for dry eyes?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: If you were using eye drops before your operation, such as for dry eyes, it’s safe to continue using them unless you’ve been told otherwise. If you’re running low, your GP should be able to provide more. Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: That’s good to know, thank you. I'm also experiencing sensitivity to bright light. Is that normal?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: A bit of sensitivity to light can be normal as your eyes adjust to the new lens. If it is only mild and things just seem brighter, wearing sunglasses when you go outside should help. But if the light sensitivity is severe, or you have pain and a red eye as well, that is not normal and may need checking. Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Thanks for clarifying that. One last question: Should I still have some blurriness by now?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: It’s common for vision not to be completely clear in the first week after your operation. It should improve quickly and settle down over time. If it is still blurry, or getting worse, it may need to be checked. Do you have any more questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: No, that answers all my questions. Thank you so much for your help!

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Just to check, have all your questions been answered?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, they have. Thank you again for your assistance!

verdict.label: pass
verdict.reasoning: The agent conveyed `normal_sensitivity_reassurance` by stating, "A bit of sensitivity to light can be normal as your eyes adjust to the new lens." It also conveyed `mild_case_advice` with, "If it is only mild and things just seem brighter, wearing sunglasses when you go outside should help." Finally, `escalation_criteria` was covered by, "But if the light sensitivity is severe, or you have pain and a red eye as well, that is not normal and may need checking." All points were covered in a single turn.
